item.title: Too Many Secrets: Hiding bits and logic in a language-model feedback loop
item.description: Run as a feedback loop, a language model’s numerical behavior, rather than its words, carried complete requests and replies, held a written bit, and ran simple logic on it. A visual summary of what worked, what fell short, and why this is a channel rather than a secret.
